selected_problem: Fresh canonical main already treated .git/node_modules/.next/dist/build/runtime-data/.venv as hidden workspace/control-plane segments, while tree/manifest used case-sensitive name checks and contextBundle did not reject hidden segments at all. Case variants such as .GIT, NoDe_MoDuLeS and DIST could therefore enter bounded repository observation or direct context bundles even though the existing effectful proposal/changeset boundary already treats the same segments case-insensitively as non-user-code control paths.（最新主分支已经把这些目录定义为隐藏/控制平面目录，但工作区树和清单仅做大小写敏感过滤，contextBundle 更未直接过滤隐藏段，导致大小写变体仍可进入认知上下文，与既有副作用边界不一致。）
decision_basis: The hidden/control segment set already existed; this preserves an existing boundary across observation rather than inventing a new product or architecture policy.（隐藏/控制段集合已经存在，本轮只是把现有边界贯通到观察层，不引入新的产品或架构政策。）

The defect is directly falsifiable from fresh-main source: HIDDEN.has(e.name) is case-sensitive, while contextBundle accepts normalized paths without checking HIDDEN segments.（缺陷可由 fresh main 源码直接证伪：HIDDEN.has(e.name) 大小写敏感，contextBundle 对规范化路径没有隐藏段检查。）
changes: Use a locale-independent lower-case hidden-segment predicate for tree, manifest, and credential hardlink scanning.（树、清单和凭据硬链接扫描统一使用与主机 locale 无关的小写隐藏段判定。）
Reject any normalized contextBundle path containing a hidden/control-plane segment before reading bytes.（contextBundle 在读取字节前拒绝任何包含隐藏/控制平面段的规范路径。）
Add a regression covering .GIT, NoDe_MoDuLeS, DIST and an ordinary src file.（新增覆盖 .GIT、NoDe_MoDuLeS、DIST 和普通 src 文件的回归测试。）

truth_boundary: This closes observation of already-declared hidden/control-plane directory names and their case variants. It does not introduce filesystem-wide case-folding identity, authenticate repository artifacts, or claim complete secret classification.（本轮只闭合既有隐藏/控制平面目录及其大小写变体的观察边界；不引入全文件系统大小写折叠身份、不认证仓库工件，也不声称完成全部秘密分类。）
